011/**
012 * Sets a pump runtime configuration value, sent as two raw config bytes.
013 *
014 * Known use: part of the Abbott FreeStyle Libre 3 sensor setup flow. Only the
015 * t:slim X2 sends this; the Mobi pump does not use it.
016 *
017 * The t:slim X2 app only ever sends {0, 0}. The meaning of the two bytes beyond
018 * that is not known, so they are left settable here for experimentation. This is a
019 * one-way command with no companion message to read the value back.
020 *
021 * Cargo layout (2 bytes):
022 *   [0] config0 uint8
023 *   [1] config1 uint8
024 *
025 * Note: this is a different message from {@link SetConfigurableFeatureRequest}, even though the
026 * two names look similar.
027 */

071public class SetRuntimeConfigRequest extends Message {
072    private int config0;
073    private int config1;
074
075    public SetRuntimeConfigRequest() {
076        this(0, 0);
077    }
078
079    public SetRuntimeConfigRequest(int config0, int config1) {
080        this.config0 = config0;
081        this.config1 = config1;
082        this.cargo = buildCargo(config0, config1);
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * <table border="1">
087     * <caption>Parsed fields for SetRuntimeConfigRequest:</caption>
088     * <tr><td><code>config0</code></td><td><code>raw[0] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
089     * <tr><td><code>config1</code></td><td><code>raw[1] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
090     * </table>
091     */
092    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
093        raw = removeSignedRequestHmacBytes(raw);
094        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == props().size());
095        this.cargo = raw;
096        this.config0 = raw[0] & 0xFF;
097        this.config1 = raw[1] & 0xFF;
098    }
099
100    public static byte[] buildCargo(int config0, int config1) {
101        return new byte[]{ (byte) config0, (byte) config1 };
102    }
103
104    public int getConfig0() {
105        return config0;
106    }
107
